## Current position

Associate Professor of Kinesiology, INEFC Lleida (Universitat de Lleida), tenured in 2026
and affiliated with the centre since 2016.

Head of Research Support and Knowledge Transfer at INEFC Lleida since 2022, and member of
the centre's Research Board.
